assertions.predicate: The deployed Worker release matches the merged revision and its registry serves finish-job and acknowledge-job-result. Release smoke does not establish audit persistence. Before live-proven, the coordinator must read a real finished no-PR audit Card through work-queue, verify its immutable status, result and report reference, observe an unacknowledged result older than 24 hours as stale, then observe acknowledgement clearing that staleness.
assertions.expected_result: Exact merged release identity and registered verbs observed. Real audit persistence, stale-result visibility and acknowledgement remain pending operational proof obligations.
assertions.input_class: Read-only release identity and verb registry; no synthetic production writes.
